To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) brand equity has a positive effect on the performance of small businesses; 2) brand equity is a function of brand loyalty, perceived quality, brand awareness and brand association; 3) the relationship between brand equity and the competitive performance is stronger when the level of customer brand loyalty is high than when it is low; 4) brand equity is more important for the competitive performance of small businesses in the trade sector than in the small manufacturing sector and the agricultural sector.
